id: title:charlesvien:default runtime and template from the task profile

review.posthog_relevance: Adds profile-dependent sandbox and runtime selection, but the profile is not passed to the downstream state, potentially breaking the workflow. This could allow a task to use a sandbox template or runtime from a stored profile, but the profile is not passed to the state, so the downstream workflow cannot use it.
